cover letter
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training (Required)

The Cal Athletics Fund Intern supports the event planning and operations of the Donor Engagement Team. This position works with event managers to plan events from start to finish, including providing day-of event support. The Cal Athletics Fund Intern works with vendors, supports Development Officers, and coordinates with coaches and other athletics staff, requiring excellent customer service skills. This position also assists with event communications, including social media and emails.
Event Planning and Administration
Under direct supervision, learns to apply professional concepts to develop, plan, organize and administer athletics programs, operating procedures and guidelines.
In particular, support the event planning and programming efforts of the Development Office including large scale, small scale and virtual events.

Supports the Development Office’s external communications program and helps ensure that information on the website and on printed materials is consistent with mission, representative of the Cal brand, well organized and cleanly proofread.
Support the development of social media strategy and plan.
Supports the execution of all football and basketball home games, staffing each game and ensuring alumni and supporters receive support with tickets and parking.
Sets up and manages tailgates and pre-game festivities; may also support away game planning and logistics.
Database Management and Analysis
Learns to use departmental databases (Advance, Salesforce, Paciolan) to prepare reports and perform analyses.
Assists with tracking event attendance and logging acknowledgements and communications.
Other duties as assigned, including professional development.

Learns about administrative areas for University Development and Alumni Relations (UDAR) and Intercollegiate Athletics such as: gift processing, donor stewardship, leadership gifts, events management, capital projects, and communications.
Inventory and Maintenance
Assists with inventory, storage, and maintenance of gear, Athletics donor signage and/or recognition plaques.
Donor Relations and Stewardship
Learns about Cal’s tiered benefits societies and multifaceted donor relations programs.
Helps direct the stewardship events associated with benefits.
Proficiency in the use of basic computer applications relevant to job duties.
Basic knowledge of and/or ability to learn program activity and best practices.
Problem-solving skills; multi-task, work with frequent interruptions, and effective listener.
Basic verbal and written communication skills in the English language.
